[[File:Gametab-Upgrades.png|centre]] '''Upgrades''' help you either directly by improving the production of your buildings and click rewards, or indirectly by increasing your [[mana]] regeneration rate, or your [[Faction Coins|faction coins]] find chance etc. Unless you are aiming for a special trophy such as [[Faction Run]], upgrades on this page are simply to be collected, unlike the [[Faction upgrades|Faction]] or [[Research]] upgrades which require strategic choices.

They are unlocked when you complete certain tasks or receive a [[trophy]], and will show up progressively in the upgrades tab when you become close to affording them. Depending on your game [[options]], upgrades can be sorted by category, by price, consolidated by series, and purchased upgrades can be hidden. It is advised to enable the option '''Don't Group Upgrades by Category''<nowiki/>' to have all the unpurchased upgrades easily at reach side by side.

Below are upgrades by category as visible in the game. (PA = Post [[Ascension]])

== Allegiances Upgrades ==
The first category in the sidebar, a player's Allegiance can refer to both [[Alignment]] and [[Factions]] and their related categories of upgrades. Only the core upgrades from this category are listed below; many of these are [[Faction upgrades]] (this group includes the series of allying Treaties). Alongside those big groups are the [[Heritages]], [[Bloodlines|Bloodline]], and the [[Royal Exchange]] interface.

!Priority Autocasting
|{{Number|400 Ud|table}}
|{{Number|12 M}} Mana Produced (Total)
|Allows you to prioritize the order of spell casting.<br />Spells with lower priority will be cast only if the higher priority spells are already active.
While offline, improves spell cast amount by 1 per minute.
|-
![[File:Autocast-5-Contingency.png]]
!Contingency Autocasting
|{{Number|500 Qad|table}}
|{{Number|20 M}} Mana Produced (Total)
|Allows you to set a minimum amount of mana before starting to Autocast. A slide bar will appear when you CTRL+Click on the mana bar. [[File:Contingency-slidebar.png]] By adjusting its height you will set a minimum amount of mana below which spells won't be cast. Once your mana reaches the threshold, spells will follow the priority rules. The contingency loop will break when you can't cast a spell, at which point the cycle will reset.
While offline, improves spell cast amount by an additional 2 per minute.
|-
![[File:Autocast-6-Planned.png]]
!Planned Autocasting
|{{Number|600 Spd|table}}
|{{Number|30 M}} Mana Produced (Total)
|Allows you to set Primary and Secondary spells. Primary spells (Set with CTRL+Click) will fire when you have max mana with Contingency Autocasting. Secondary spells (Set with SHIFT+Click) will fire as soon as you have the mana, as long as the primary spells are ALL still active.
While offline, increases [[mana]] produced by an additional 10% of your mana regeneration per second and your [[spells]] cast amount by an additional 2 per minute.
|-
![[File:Autocast-7-Efficient.png]]
!Efficient Autocasting
|{{Number|700 Vg|table}}
|{{Number|50 M}} Mana Produced (Total)
|Allows you to select Independent Spells, (a bronze icon set with CTRL+SHIFT+Click) to work outside of contingency settings. These spells disregard your contingency rules and are casted as soon as you have enough mana for them.
While offline, increases mana produced amount by an additional 10% of your mana regen per second and spell cast amount by 2 per minute.
|-
![[File:Autocast8_upgrade.png]]
!Tiered Autocasting {{PA}}
|{{Number|800 Vg|table}}
|{{Number|200M}} Mana Produced (Total)
|Only for [[Spells#Tier Spell Upgrades .28R42.2B.29|Tier upgraded Spells]]. Allows you to set the maximum tier you wish to autocast each spell to.<br />In the spell tooltip, use the diamond icon to change its mode until you get to the desired maximum tier number. Spells will still follow their previous priority rules.
Only while offline, increase mana produced by an additional 10% of your mana regeneration per second and your spells cast amount by an additional 3 per minute. (Caps at 90%)
|}
</table-progress-tracking>
